8.A. RES - Adjourn Meeting
Item 8-A

The Board continues to strongly encourage members of the public to communicate with the Board, including via email,
SpeakUp!, and during Public Comment Time. Because Board meetings are broadcast live on cable TV and the internet, and
past Board meetings are available on the County website, younger members of the public may be listening and/or viewing the
meetings, including public comment time. During Public Comment Time, members of the public shall refrain from obscenity or
other speech tending to create a breach of the peace, as such language violates the Board’s Rules of Procedure. The Board also
strongly encourages speakers during Public Comment Time to follow proper decorum and be respectful to each other; and to
refrain from using profanity, as such language is not suitable for younger members of the public who may be viewing and/or
listening to the meeting. The Board appreciates the public’s cooperation in communicating important feedback and
information to the Board in a positive, productive, and respectful manner.

To register to comment remotely at Public Comment Time, please visit SpeakUp! Prince William

Online registration will open at 9:00 a.m. on Tuesday, April 7 and close at 5:00 p.m. on Monday, April 13.

RE: APPOINT – BRIAN LANDRUM – PLANNING COMMISSION

ACTION:

WHEREAS, due to the resignation of Cynthia Moses-Nedd, there is a vacancy for a
Regular Woodbridge Magisterial District Representative to the Planning Commission; and

WHEREAS, Supervisor LaCroix desires to appoint Brian Landrum as the Regular
Woodbridge Magisterial District Representative to the Planning Commission; and

WHEREAS, a Notice of Intent to Appoint Brian Landrum as the Regular Woodbridge
Magisterial District Representative to the Planning Commission was offered at the meeting of the
Prince William Board of County Supervisors on March 31, 2026;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED that the Prince William Board of County
Supervisors hereby appoints Brian Landrum as the Regular Woodbridge Magisterial District
Representative to the Planning Commission;

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the term of office for this appointment is
coterminous with that of the Board of County Supervisors, which appointed them, and they shall
serve at the pleasure of the Board during that term.

Skills:

Michael Garcia is the VP of Development at Mike Garcia Construction Inc. He
began his career in the family-owned company after graduating from the University
of Virginia with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Biology/Biochemistry in 2005.
Michael began his career as a commercial construction superintendent building
office, medical office, laboratory and industrial construction projects in Prince William, Fairfax, and
Loudoun Counties. He now assists the President of Mike Garcia Construction, Mike Garcia, in all
commercial
developments.

He is responsible for the due diligence prior to land acquisition, entitling, budget,
ﬁnance, project design and marketing, and site/building plan permit approvals.
Additionally, Michael heads the property management division for Mike Garcia
Construction whereby he maintains the commercial properties held in Mike Garcia’s
portfolio.
